item.title: Incarico post-doc: Post-doc assignment (Univ. GENOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. GENOVA, Genova
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-04 Diritto del lavoro

The post-doctoral researcher will be required to conduct research in the field of Labour Law, with a particular focus on employment relationships within the context of business fragmentation. The research should begin with a review of the current state of the art before identifying avenues for further scholarly inquiry. In exploring the most promising frontiers, due consideration must be given to transformations in inter-firm relationships—particularly those creating power imbalances—driven by technological innovations, the adoption of new organizational and management models, and the spread of associated new contractual arrangements.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Corporate Sustainability and Due Diligence Obligations: Implications for Party Autonomy and Tort Liability (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-01 Diritto privato

The research builds upon Directive (EU) 2024/1760 on corporate sustainability due diligence and Directive (EU) 2022/2464 on corporate sustainability reporting, with the aim of examining their implications for private law, with reference to contract law and civil liability.
